name: real
about: The real look on (docs/briefs/red-dead.md R0): --look=res://config/looks/real.json for a run, or a screenshots.gd --variants= file (one run renders both looks; frames: how long it settles, for TAA and SDFGI). Its renderer's dials are real_dials.json; its own are the look addresses real.* (RealLook.dials) and view.* (the game viewport), set here to their defaults so a variant before it can't leave its own.
